arguments.sql:
SELECT c.hasContentWarning, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.uuid IN (
    SELECT l.uuid
    FROM legalities AS l
    WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
)
GROUP BY c.hasContentWarning;
